headline: Executive order aims to improve accountability and protect whistleblowers at the Department of Veterans Affairs.
what_it_does: This executive order directs the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to take steps to hold its employees accountable and to protect workers who report wrongdoing. No summary was provided, so the specific actions it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by new accountability steps and by protections for those who report problems.
VA workers who report wrongdoing may receive added protection under the order.
They may be indirectly affected by changes in how the VA oversees its staff.

when_it_takes_effect: Executive orders usually take effect when signed; this one was signed on April 27, 2017.
